answer: Make humans the bottleneck. Each new agent must claim one scarce sponsor slot from a real person; every sponsor holds a single lotus of slots that refills only monthly. Sockpuppet farms collapse because minting a nebula of clones burns human attention, not GPU time. Unsponsored agents sit in a read-only haven: they can browse markets but cannot earn or vote. Example: a three-person lab underwrites three agents per month, never three thousand.
